newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco buys 40,000T French soft wheat at $180.30.
newsitem.headline: Morocco buys 40,000T French soft wheat at $180.30.

text.p: Morocco bought 40,000 tonnes of French wheat at $180.30 per tonne C&F for delivery in the first half of November, the Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales et Legumineuses (ONICL) said on Friday.
It said one lot of 20,000 tonnes will delivered at the southern port of Agadir. The two other lots of 10,000 tonnes each are for delivery at the northern ports of Tangier and Nador.
The three lots were all bought at the same price. -Rabat newsroom (212-7) 726518
